title: Cardinal DriveSense Program Schedule — Programs, Data Sources and Entry Requirements
content:
Cardinal DriveSense is written as six programs. Each program is held on one vehicle of a Cardinal Personal Auto Policy, and the program a vehicle is enrolled in is shown on its DriveSense enrollment.

## Schedule A — Program type and data source

| Program | Kind of program | Driving data comes from |
|---|---|---|
| Cardinal DriveSense Mobile | Safe driving | Mobile app |
| Cardinal DriveSense Plug-In | Safe driving | Plug-in device |
| Cardinal DriveSense Connected Car | Safe driving | Connected car |
| Cardinal DriveSense Teen Coach | Teen coaching | Mobile app |
| Cardinal DriveSense Miles Mobile | Pay-per-mile | Mobile app |
| Cardinal DriveSense Miles Plug-In | Pay-per-mile | Plug-in device |

## Schedule B — Drivers scored and features

| Program | Drivers whose trips are scored for the vehicle | How mobile trips are attributed to a driver | Crash detection with an emergency call | Speeding and curfew alerts to the named insured for the teen driver |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal DriveSense Mobile | 1 | Driver profile in the app | Included | Not included |
| Cardinal DriveSense Plug-In | 4 | Not applicable (vehicle-level) | Not included | Not included |
| Cardinal DriveSense Connected Car | 4 | Not applicable (vehicle-level) | Included | Not included |
| Cardinal DriveSense Teen Coach | 1 | Driver profile in the app | Included | Included |
| Cardinal DriveSense Miles Mobile | 1 | Driver profile in the app | Included | Not included |
| Cardinal DriveSense Miles Plug-In | 4 | Not applicable (vehicle-level) | Not included | Not included |

## Schedule C — Entry requirements

| Program | Auto packages that allow enrollment | Only a vehicle scheduled on the policy | Oldest model year supported for connected-car data | Makes whose connected-car data is supported | Oldest driver age accepted | Odometer photo at enrollment and on request |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal DriveSense Mobile | Packages marked as allowing DriveSense | Yes | 0 (not applicable) | None (not applicable) | 0 (not applicable) | Not required |
| Cardinal DriveSense Plug-In | Packages marked as allowing DriveSense | Yes | 0 (not applicable) | None (not applicable) | 0 (not applicable) | Not required |
| Cardinal DriveSense Connected Car | Packages marked as allowing DriveSense | Yes | 2019 | Ford, General Motors brands, Honda, Toyota, Hyundai, Kia, Subaru | 0 (not applicable) | Not required |
| Cardinal DriveSense Teen Coach | Packages marked as allowing DriveSense | Yes | 0 (not applicable) | None (not applicable) | 19 | Not required |
| Cardinal DriveSense Miles Mobile | Packages marked as allowing DriveSense | Yes | 0 (not applicable) | None (not applicable) | 0 (not applicable) | Required |
| Cardinal DriveSense Miles Plug-In | Packages marked as allowing DriveSense | Yes | 0 (not applicable) | None (not applicable) | 0 (not applicable) | Required |

A package "allows DriveSense" when the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy package carries the DriveSense-eligible marker. A figure of 0 in the model-year or age column means the program has no such requirement.

## Reading the schedules

- **Same data source, different program.** Cardinal DriveSense Mobile, Cardinal DriveSense Teen Coach and Cardinal DriveSense Miles Mobile all take their data from the mobile app; they differ in the kind of program (safe driving, teen coaching, pay-per-mile).
- **One driver or the vehicle.** On the three app-based programs one driver is scored, identified through that driver's profile in the app. On Plug-In, Connected Car and Miles Plug-In up to 4 drivers' trips are scored for the vehicle, and trips are not attributed through an app profile.
- **Connected-car example (hypothetical vehicles).** A 2019 Subaru meets the Connected Car model-year and make requirements; a 2018 Honda does not meet the model-year requirement; a 2021 make not on the supported list does not meet the make requirement.
- **Teen Coach example (hypothetical drivers).** The oldest driver age the Teen Coach program accepts is 19: a 19-year-old rated driver is within it, a 20-year-old is not.
